name: Mahabodhi Temple Complex at Bodh Gaya
description: In Bodh Gaya, in India's Bihar state, a brick temple tower rises over 55 metres beside a tree descended from the one under which the Buddha is said to have found enlightenment. Pilgrims have come here for over two thousand years. The temple standing today dates from around the 6th century, and it is among India's oldest surviving brick temples.
